use_when.text: Use avatars to provide clear visual identification of users or entities.
use_when.source: Figma 69:2101 (Avatar Doc Frame › Do, text I69:2101;2406:461;69:2097)

use_when.text: Use the appropriate size based on the context and layout.
use_when.source: Figma 69:2101 (Avatar Doc Frame › Do, text I69:2101;2406:461;69:2097)

use_when.text: Use a profile image when a user’s photo is available.
use_when.source: Figma 69:2101 (Avatar Doc Frame › Do, text I69:2101;2406:461;69:2097)

use_when.text: Maintain consistent shape, sizing, and spacing across similar contexts.
use_when.source: Figma 69:2101 (Avatar Doc Frame › Do, text I69:2101;2406:461;69:2097)

use_when.text: Use accessible alternative text or labels when the avatar conveys meaningful information.
use_when.source: Figma 69:2101 (Avatar Doc Frame › Do, text I69:2101;2406:461;69:2097)

use_when.text: Use status indicators only when they provide relevant and useful information.
use_when.source: Figma 69:2101 (Avatar Doc Frame › Do, text I69:2101;2406:461;69:2097)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use inconsistent sizes or shapes for avatars serving the same purpose.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:2101 (Avatar Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:2101;2406:416;69:2094)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use distorted, stretched, or low-quality profile images.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:2101 (Avatar Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:2101;2406:416;69:2094)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t rely on the avatar alone to communicate important information.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:2101 (Avatar Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:2101;2406:416;69:2094)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t overcrowd avatars with unnecessary badges or status indicators.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:2101 (Avatar Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:2101;2406:416;69:2094)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use decorative images that could be mistaken for a user or entity avatar.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:2101 (Avatar Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:2101;2406:416;69:2094)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t remove accessible labels when the avatar represents a specific person or entity.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:2101 (Avatar Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:2101;2406:416;69:2094)

2xl.source: Figma 32:315 (Avatar component set › variant 32:324 description, repeated on every size=2xl variant)

icon.text: when there is no photo or logo, or for an entity without one, such as a job category.

placement.text: EmployerProfile mounts an xl rectangle-image Avatar as its first child, before the employer title and the optional helper line.
NavItems mounts an xl circle-image Avatar as its last child, after NavLabel and the two IconButtons (bell and mail).

a11y.text: Renders a <span> with no role or aria attributes of its own.
The image categories render a native with the `alt` prop, which defaults to an empty string.
The icon category’s icon is aria-hidden="true" and focusable="false".
